citations.cypher:
CALL {
  MATCH (e:Event)-[:IS_TYPE]->(:EventType {name: 'person_entry'})-[:DETECTED_BY]->(c:Camera {camera_location: 'Gate_MainEntrance'})
  WHERE e.timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND e.timestamp_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
  RETURN count(e) AS n
  UNION ALL
  MATCH (e:Event)-[:IS_TYPE]->(:EventType {name: 'person_exit'})-[:DETECTED_BY]->(c:Camera {camera_location: 'Gate_MainEntrance'})
  WHERE e.timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND e.timestamp_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
  RETURN count(e) AS n
}
RETURN sum(n) AS total_people_through_main_entrance
